channel.title: Daily brief - Martin Jordanovski
channel.description: AI, technology and software development news, summarised every morning. Leadership, psychology and investing on Mondays.

item.title: Daily brief, 25 Nov 2026
item.description:
Nvidia's Jensen Huang returns as CEO after an affair-related exit: Huang apologised to staff at his first all-hands since returning as Nvidia's CEO and said he was grateful for a second chance. He also denied reports that the White House helped get him rehired, after the company's earlier investigation into his personal conduct drew scrutiny.
Rust 1.100 stabilises the never type after a decade of work: Rust 1.100.0, released 12 November 2026, stabilises the never type (!) and makes Infallible an alias for it. It also stabilises the core of the allocator API, adds DropGuard, and adds an opt-in dependency cooldown setting for Cargo.
Microsoft declares internal 'Code Red' after near-24-hour Outlook and Exchange outage: Microsoft declared an unusual internal 'Code Red' after an Exchange Online and Outlook outage that lasted nearly 24 hours and disrupted email for millions of customers. The outage was traced to a bug that had been sitting on Microsoft 365 networking gateway servers.
